name: The Summit
intro: The light is a room, and the room has someone in it, and they have been expecting you for a very long time.

nodes.label: The Doorway
nodes.text: They do not turn around. They already know exactly how you are standing.

nodes.label: Cross The Room
nodes.text: It is further than it looks. Everything here is.

nodes.label: Breathe
nodes.text: Whatever they say next, you would rather hear it with a slow pulse.

nodes.label: The Way Out
nodes.text: The loop opens like a held breath finally let go.
